reviewer.memoryUse: verification-checklist-only; every finding reverified against the target revision

validation.scope: current prototype and foundation only; not the unimplemented production architecture

findings.summary: The Gate 2 artifact does not contain or bind the accepted production exit exam.
evidence: intent/0001/EXAM.md:3-7 derives only from the Brief and Spec and binds no exact approved revision or Architecture revision 2
intent/0001/ARCHITECTURE.md:229-255 defines thirteen mandatory Phase 1 exit cases
intent/0001/PLAN.md:15-22 requires the original Exam and all thirteen architecture cases
kit/policy/gates.json:19-22 makes EXAM the governed Gate 2 artifact
findings.requiredResolution: Issue a revision-bound Gate 2 Exam that incorporates the complete accepted production exit exam.

findings.summary: Required tenancy and signature safety invariants are missing from the Exam.
evidence: intent/0001/ARCHITECTURE.md:173-182 requires the complete signature envelope
intent/0001/ARCHITECTURE.md:257-263 requires negative isolation tests at every named boundary
intent/0001/EXAM.md:25-28 checks only identity, sequence, and revision
intent/0001/EXAM.md:74-83 omits the cross-tenant, agent-never-signs, distinct-signer, and separate-session matrices
findings.requiredResolution: Add complete signature-envelope and cross-tenant negative matrices, including agent refusal and signer-policy cases.

findings.summary: Builder write-protection is asserted but not enforced by required CI.
evidence: intent/0001/EXAM.md:5-7 claims the hook enforces protection
kit/policy/gates.json:60-63 makes Builder EXAM immutability an invariant
scripts/check-exam-protection.mjs:1-13 exists but is not called by package.json
.github/workflows/repository-contract.yml:57-61 runs pnpm check without an actor-bound EXAM protection check
findings.requiredResolution: Make EXAM protection a required actor-bound CI control rather than an opt-in local hook.

findings.summary: The pass condition omits the accepted outcome contract.
evidence: intent/0001/BRIEF.md:24-32 defines the 90-day outcome and guardrail
intent/0001/PLAN.md:15-22 distinguishes technical release from outcome completion
intent/0001/EXAM.md:102-106 can pass without proving the accepted product outcome
findings.requiredResolution: Define separate technical-release and outcome-complete verdicts, including ten real items and the 90-day measures.

findings.summary: Several cases are not independently reproducible.
evidence: intent/0001/EXAM.md:11-18 does not freeze combinations, serialization, or storage-crawl boundaries
intent/0001/EXAM.md:47-51 does not freeze the prompt corpus or regression baseline
intent/0001/EXAM.md:95-100 does not define environment, repetitions, percentile calculation, clocks, or evidence outputs
tests/performance.test.ts:5-14 uses one in-process timing sample and models no repositories
tests/reconciliation-chaos.test.ts:7-17 times a local function rather than event-to-board latency or ten-minute wall-clock recovery
findings.requiredResolution: Specify versioned fixtures, deterministic seeds, canonical serialization, environments, clocks, repetitions, percentile method, and retained evidence for every quantitative case.

findings.summary: Default-closed domain activation and specialist evidence are under-specified.
evidence: intent/0001/EXAM.md:3-7 declares only security, privacy, and accessibility
kit/policy/gates.json:4-12 also defaults reliability and irreversible operations closed
intent/0001/EXAM.md:102-106 does not identify activated domains, signer hats, evidence, or revision binding
kit/templates/EXAM.md:35-38 requires a current signature for every activated default-closed domain
findings.requiredResolution: Resolve applicability explicitly and bind each activated domain's specialist evidence to the current Exam revision; rerun Gate 1 if signed Brief domain tags change.
